title: Num Lock(under Keyboard Management) is not working as expected for my Numpad Keyboard

status.label: Retest Num Lock remapping on current stable
status.detail: The report uses PowerToys 0.74.1 and an 18-key numpad; the current hook restores Num Lock state when a Num Lock keydown is suppressed, so verify whether the behavior remains.

judgment.rationale: The report describes an 18-key numpad where remapping Num Lock to Right still toggles Num Lock and changes navigation keys such as Home, Insert, and End to number output. It requests an option resembling the Keyboard Manager numpad setting, but the report is from PowerToys 0.74.1. The current hook contains explicit handling to restore the prior Num Lock state when the Num Lock event is suppressed, so the first decision is whether the behavior persists on current stable and with Num Lock on/off.
evidence: The report lists PowerToys 0.74.1, Microsoft Store installation, and administrator execution.
The reporter uses an 18-key numpad and tries to remap Num Lock to Right or another key.
The reported side effect is that Num Lock state changes and navigation functions such as Home, Insert, and End instead enter numbers.
The issue requests an option similar to the Keyboard Manager numpad setting; there are no comments or assignees.
Current KeyboardManager.cpp and KeyboardManagerEditor.cpp restore the previous Num Lock state when a Num Lock keydown is suppressed; the report predates this observed code path.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask whether the same behavior persists on v0.102.3001 with Num Lock initially on and off, and confirm which navigation keys are affected.

fix_assessment.rationale: The report describes a possible state-preservation defect when suppressing Num Lock, but its version predates the current explicit Num Lock state restoration and needs a current retest.

proposed_fixes.title: Verify Num Lock state preservation when remapping the Num Lock key
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Suppressing a Num Lock event may not preserve the keyboard state on the reporter's 18-key numpad, although current hook code attempts to restore the prior state; the outcome has not been verified on current stable.
plan: Retest Num Lock-to-Right with Num Lock initially on and off on v0.102.3001.
Record whether the Num Lock indicator/state changes and whether Home, Insert, End, or other navigation keys produce the expected outputs.
If the state still changes when the key is remapped, trace the suppressed keydown/key-up path and add a focused regression test.
verification: Confirm remapping Num Lock does not unexpectedly toggle the numpad state.
Verify navigation keys retain their expected behavior with Num Lock on and off.

confidence.rationale: The report is detailed but comes from 0.74.1, and current code already includes Num Lock state restoration whose effect on this report is unverified.

inferences: The observed number/navigation change may be caused by Num Lock state changing before or despite the remap; current code explicitly restores Num Lock state for suppressed keydowns, but the report predates it.
